we curate and release Dolma, a three-trillion-token English corpus, built from a diverse mixture of web content, scientific papers, code, public-domain books, social media, and encyclopedic materials.

atoms.reference: To facilitate scientific research on language model pretraining, where commercial models rarely detail their data and open models are often released without training data or recipes.

evidence.record_quote: To facilitate scientific research on language model pretraining
commercial models rarely detail their data, and even open models are often released without accompanying training data or recipes to reproduce them.

atoms.reference: Extensive documentation (design principles, construction, a summary of contents), analyses of intermediate states, and an open-sourced data curation toolkit for reproduction.

evidence.record_quote: We extensively document Dolma, including its design principles, details about its construction, and a summary of its contents.
We present analyses and experimental results on intermediate states of Dolma to share what we have learned about important data curation practices.
we open-source our data curation toolkit to enable reproduction of our work as well as support further research in large-scale data curation.
